model_selection_note: This is the model the runtime reported for this worker. It was not chosen by this worker and could not be changed from inside it. See workstreams/po03/control/model-capability-register.json.
producer_and_coordinator_separation_reas: The commission requires a different producer to accept a result. One worker executed every unit and also compiled the wave, so no separation existed. This is why no unit is COMPLETED and every independent_acceptance field is NOT_TESTED.

gate_discipline.transcription_note: Only the final gate run is transcribed verbatim below. The intermediate runs were observed in-session but are not reproduced here, because pasting remembered console text would be weaker evidence than the fact that every gate is re-runnable at this head.

defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.defect: The CI diff base fell back to a merge-base against origin/main, which pulled pre-existing base-branch content into the changed-path set and would have failed the guard on files this Wave never authored.
defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.repair: .github/workflows/po03-contracts.yml resolves the PO-03 base ref before origin/main
defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.regression_test_note: The fixture reproduces the failure on real git history: a base branch carrying an out-of-allowlist file, a wave branch touching only allowlisted files, and a guard that fails against the main base and passes against the PO-03 base. A second check, test_ci_workflow_prefers_the_po03_base_ref_over_main, asserts the workflow keeps that ordering.

defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.defect: Default rename detection reported only the destination of a rename, so moving a file from outside the allowlist into it hid the out-of-allowlist deletion and the guard passed.
A tracked symlink inside the subtree caused the manifest to hash content from outside the subtree, so the manifest could certify bytes it did not cover.
defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.repair: manifest.py rejects git modes 120000 and 160000 and refuses to hash a symlink

defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.defect: The schemas declare additionalProperties:false but the validator accepted unknown keys at every object level, so the enforced contract was looser than the published one.
defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.repair: closed key sets enforced at every level, plus a test that fails if the validator and schema ever disagree again

defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.defect: The manifest could be generated while untracked files existed in the subtree, silently certifying an incomplete file set.
defects_found_in_this_wave_by_this_produ.repair: manifest generation fails closed when an untracked, non-ignored file exists in the subtree

defects_found_in_this_wave_own_evidence.detail: Three control records were written with claims narrower than their wording: the single-writer statement, the remote-branch list and the zero-collision count. All three were caught by re-measuring at the end of the Wave rather than reusing an earlier observation, and all three were corrected in place with the superseded wording retained.
defects_found_in_this_wave_own_evidence.most_material: collision_count was 0 and is 1. The PR base branch advanced 14 commits during the Wave and 17 of this Wave's changed paths also changed there, including the seeded validator and its test module. On a literal reading this means the commission's Wave B gate, which requires zero path collision, is not met.

defect_discovery_independence_note: All eight defects, five in the code and three in the evidence, were found by the producer reviewing its own work. Self-review that finds real defects is worth more than none, but it is not the independent adversarial review the commission asks for, and the fact that three evidence records were wrong on first writing is itself a reason to re-measure rather than trust any count in this Wave.
external_research_reason: No browse or search tool is available in this runtime. Plain curl reaches cursor.com, but there is no way to search or render practitioner repositories, papers and communities at the scale the commission envisions. Rather than cite sources it did not fetch, this Wave reproduced eight well-established engineering hypotheses inside this repository's own code and marked the external corpus NOT_YET.
unverified_prior_citations_note: workstreams/po03/evidence/so02-operating-correction.json contains model documentation URLs that this session could not verify and did not reuse. It was left unmodified; the observation is recorded in workstreams/po03/evidence/model-allocation-and-exceptions.json.

boundaries_observed.out_of_allowlist_demonstration_method: Synthetic path strings and throwaway git repositories under the system temporary directory only.

anti_fabrication_controls.rule: Every SHA-256 recorded in this Wave was computed from a real file or git object; every PASS came from a command that actually ran; every timestamp came from date -u.
anti_fabrication_controls.enforcement_detail: Forty machine checks scan every PO-03 JSON and JSONL document: any 40-hex string must resolve to a real commit in this repository, any cited test must exist as a real file and method, no document may claim acceptance, and the frozen source hashes must match the blobs at the branch point.
